title: Verify user can search for products by keyword
description: Positive test for product search functionality
preconditions: User is logged in and on the product catalogue page

steps.action: Navigate to the product catalogue page

expected_outcome: Search results display products matching the keyword with name, price, and thumbnail
given: A logged-in user on the product catalogue page
when: The user enters 'laptop' in the search field and clicks search
then: The system displays products matching 'laptop' with name, price, and thumbnail

title: Validate search with no matching results
description: Negative test for product search with no results
preconditions: User is logged in and on the product catalogue page

steps.action: Navigate to the product catalogue page

steps.expected_result: System displays a no results message

expected_outcome: System displays a friendly no results found message
given: A logged-in user on the product catalogue page
when: The user enters 'xyznonexistent999' in the search field and clicks search
then: The system displays a no results found message with search suggestions

title: Verify user can add product to shopping cart
description: Positive test for shopping cart add functionality
preconditions: User is logged in and viewing a product detail page

steps.action: Navigate to a product detail page
Click the Add to Cart button
steps.expected_result: Product is added to the cart
Cart displays the added product with correct details

expected_outcome: Product appears in the shopping cart with correct name, price, and quantity
given: A logged-in user viewing a product detail page
when: The user clicks the Add to Cart button
then: The product appears in the shopping cart with correct name, price, and quantity of 1

title: Validate adding out-of-stock product to cart
description: Negative test for adding unavailable product to cart
preconditions: User is logged in and viewing an out-of-stock product

steps.action: Navigate to an out-of-stock product detail page
Attempt to click the Add to Cart button
steps.expected_result: Button is disabled or shows an error message

expected_outcome: System prevents adding out-of-stock product and displays appropriate message
given: A logged-in user viewing an out-of-stock product detail page
when: The user attempts to click the Add to Cart button
then: The system prevents the action and displays an out-of-stock message

title: Verify user can complete checkout with valid payment
preconditions: User is logged in with items in cart and valid payment method saved
expected_outcome: Order is placed successfully with confirmation number displayed
given: A logged-in user with items in cart and a valid payment method
when: The user proceeds to checkout and places the order
then: The system processes the order and displays a confirmation with order number

title: Validate checkout with expired payment method
description: Negative test for checkout with invalid payment
preconditions: User is logged in with items in cart and an expired payment method
expected_outcome: System rejects the expired payment and displays an appropriate error message
given: A logged-in user with items in cart and an expired payment method
when: The user proceeds to checkout and attempts to place the order
then: The system rejects the payment and displays an error asking to update payment details
